seed_ledger.name: Cheyenne Power Hub supply (Rockies Express)
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_ROW. REX Switchgrass Lateral, FERC CP26-28-000 prior notice filed 2025-11-18: 7.2 miles of 36-inch pipe from a new interconnect at the Cheyenne Hub (Weld County, Colorado) to a new meter station in Laramie County, Wyoming, 419,000 Dth/d, $57.3 million, fuel for a cogeneration and fuel cell plant. Tallgrass says the Cheyenne Power Hub is fueled through REX, and the hub sits next to the Project Jade data center campus. Not on roster. In-service date reported as October 2026 then early 2028 (unconfirmed). Searches run: 7. Sources checked: Federal Register CP26-28 notice (length, size, purpose); Tallgrass release May 2026 (REX supply); Power Engineering and DatacenterDynamics (data center campus tie); roster grep (no match); Measured AI Substack (lead only, not cited).

Still looks like a tap on an existing Energy Transfer line. Revisit if a segment appears. Searches run: 11.
